info.name: Cloud AI Commerce Platform
info.description:
Controller extraction summary:

- GatewayHealthController: GET /api/gateway/health
- AuthController: POST /api/v1/auth/login, POST /api/v1/auth/refresh, GET /api/v1/auth/validate, GET /api/v1/auth/health
- ProductController: GET /api/v1/products/health, GET /api/v1/products, GET /api/v1/products/hot, GET /api/v1/products/admin-demo, GET /api/v1/products/user-demo, GET /api/v1/products/{id}
- ProductRagSyncController: POST /api/v1/product-sync/products, PUT /api/v1/product-sync/products/{productCode}, DELETE /api/v1/product-sync/products/{productCode}
- InventoryController: GET /api/inventory/health, GET /api/inventory/{productCode}, POST /api/inventory/reserve, POST /api/inventory/release, POST /api/inventory/deduct, POST /api/inventory/demo/concurrent-reserve
- OrderController: GET /api/orders/health, POST /api/orders, GET /api/orders/{orderNo}, GET /api/orders/status/{orderNo}, POST /api/orders/{orderNo}/cancel, POST /api/orders/demo/concurrent-create
- AiController: GET /api/v1/ai/health, GET /api/v1/ai/recommendations, GET /api/v1/ai/recommendations/{productCode}, POST /api/v1/ai/chat
- RagController: POST /api/v1/ai/ask
- ConversationController: GET /api/v1/ai/conversation/{conversationId}, DELETE /api/v1/ai/conversation/{conversationId}

GatewayService currently proxies Product, Inventory, and Order routes. AuthService and AiService are direct-service folders.
